events.title: Rebound Expected For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market on Wednesday snapped the three-day winning streak in which it had gathered almost 30 points or 0.8 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,710-point plateau although it's likely to bounce higher again on Thursday.

events.title: Australian Market Notably Lower
events.description: The Australian market is trading notably lower on Thursday, reversing the gains in the previous session, despite the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is falling below the 8,800 level, with weakness across most sectors led by in mining and energy stocks.

events.title: Tech Shares May Extend Taiwan Bourse Rally
events.description: The Taiwan stock market on Wednesday ended the two-day losing streak in which it had given up almost 820 points or 1.7 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just beneath the 46,890-point plateau and it's expected to see continued support on Thursday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market Tipped To Open To The Upside
events.description: The Singapore stock market on Wednesday ended the two-day losing streak in which it had dipped more than 10 points or 0.2 percent. The STI now sits just above the 5,435-point plateau and it's likely to open in the green again on Thursday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Tick Higher Again On Thursday
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has finished higher in back-to-back sessions, collecting more than 5 points or 0.3 percent in that span. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,600-point plateau and it may see mild upside again on Thursday.

events.title: Japan Stock Market May See Additional Support
events.description: The Japan stock market on Wednesday halted the two-day slide in which it had tumbled almost 1,300 points or 2 percent. The Nikkei now sits just above the 64,620-point plateau and it may add to its winnings on Thursday.

events.title: New Zealand Overall Inflation +0.7% On Quarter In Q3
events.description: Overall consumer prices in New Zealand were up 0.7 percent on quarter in the third quarter of 2026, Statistics New Zealand said on Thursday.

events.title: South Korea Shares May Extend Wednesday's Gains
events.description: The South Korea stock market bounced higher again on Wednesday, one day after ending the two-day winning streak in which it had rallied more than 210 points or 3.6 percent. The KOSPI now sits just above the 5,810-point plateau and it may see additional upside on Thursday.

events.title: South Korea Rate Decision On Tap For Thursday
events.description: The Bank of Korea will wrap up its monetary policy meeting on Thursday and then announce its decision on interest rates, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity. The BoK is expected to keep its benchmark unchanged at 3.00 percent.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Ends Roughly Flat As Investors Assess Middle East Developments
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value changed a little on Wednesday as traders adopted a wait-and-watch approach amid conflicting reports on a possible U.S.-Iran peace deal while economists speculated that the U.S. Federal Reserve could hold the interest rates steady in its upcoming October 27-28 meeting.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends On Firm Note
events.description: After struggling a bit for support early on in the session, Swiss stocks edged higher and eventually ended on a firm note on Wednesday as investors kept their focus firmly on earnings.

events.title: European Stocks Close On Firm Note As Focus Shifts To Earnings
events.description: European stocks snapped recent losses and closed higher on Wednesday as optimism about corporate earnings helped offset worries about oil prices, and concerns about geopolitical tensions to some extent.

events.title: Elon Musk Confirms Talks For Potential SpaceX-Tesla Merger
events.description: Elon Musk, the CEO of both Tesla Inc. and Space Exploration Technologies Corp. or SpaceX, has confirmed the discussion for potential merger of the electric vehicle major and the spaceflight company. During the third-quarter earnings call of SpaceX, a company he founded, Musk called it to be a good idea, adding that the companies have formed special committees to discuss the possible union.
